<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Running Kick](/Feats.aspx?ID=5429) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 67

**Archetype** [Beastmaster](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=50)

**Prerequisites**
[Beastmaster Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=1900); animal companion with a foot, hoof, or talon unarmed attack

</column>

---

Your companion weaves in and out of combat, swiftly attacking before getting to a better position. Your companions with a qualifying unarmed attack learn the Running Kick activity.

 **Running Kick** <actions string="Two Actions" /> This companion Strides up to twice its Speed and makes a hoof, foot, or talon Strike at any point during the movement. This movement doesn't provoke reactions from a creature damaged by the Strike.
name: Running Kick
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a foot, hoof, or talon unarmed attack
